collection.title: Toyota Celica 1994 to 1999 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Toyota Celica Mk6 1994 to 1999 will fit, this model requires a 21" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Celica which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
